data: In subplot b, is the maximum value of Change of Bleu Score 0?

The question asks whether the maximum value of the Change of Bleu Score in subplot b is 0. From the caption, we can see that the y-axis represents the Change of BLEU Score. In subplot b, there are three lines representing different types of noisy inputs: Encoder Input, Encoder Output, and Decoder Input. 

Looking at the graph, the maximum value of the Change of Bleu Score for all three lines appears to be around -8, not 0. Therefore, the answer to the question is no, the maximum value of the Change of Bleu Score is not 0.
